Implementation Plan

Clarification mapping:
- No `Q<ID>` clarification questions were asked in this issue.
- `/answer [auto-answered-by-orchestrator]` is interpretable as “proceed with the issue-defined scope as-is.”

Conflict detected:
- The issue says “consolidate eight orchestrator poll fetch sites,” but current `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` has 3 direct `actions/runs` fetch blocks (plus separate `actions/workflows/*/runs` probes for validation). Plan will consolidate all current `actions/runs` sites.

Implementation plan

1. Files likely to change
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`
- `scripts/ai_memory.py`
- `scripts/ai_memory_lib.py`
- `ai-memory/schemas/actions_runs_cache.v1.json` (new)
- `README.md`
- `agents.md` (env-var reference section is present, so update is required)
- `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py` (or equivalent poller tests)
- `tests/test_ai_memory_processed_command_entry.py` or a new focused ai-memory cache test file

2. Functions/modules to implement
- In `scripts/ai_memory_lib.py`:
- Add schema-backed validator for actions-runs cache payloads.
- Add safe repo-key/path resolver for per-repo cache file storage under `ai-memory`.
- Add read/write helpers used by CLI commands.
- In `scripts/ai_memory.py`:
- Add `actions-runs-cache` command group with:
- `get --repo <owner/repo>`
- `put --repo <owner/repo> --runs-file <path> --etag <string>`
- Wire both commands into `build_parser()`.
- Implement fail-open behavior: schema mismatch/corruption returns cache miss and emits `rate_limit_audit_fallback` warning.
- In `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`:
- Add `ACTIONS_RUNS_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` default/sanitization block (default `60`, invalid -> warning + fallback).
- Add `_load_actions_runs_cached` that:
- Reads cache via `ai_memory.py actions-runs-cache get`.
- Returns cached blob when fresh.
- Otherwise performs one `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs?per_page=100`, sending `If-None-Match` when cached etag exists.
- On `304`, refreshes `fetched_at` via `put` without changing runs.
- On `200`, persists latest runs + etag via `put`.
- Refactor all current `actions/runs` consumers (`build_active_issue_set`, `cancel_zombie_runs_for_issue`, `invoke_stall_judge`) to jq-filter the shared blob while preserving current selection behavior.

3. Data structures affected
- New schema: `ai-memory/schemas/actions_runs_cache.v1.json`:
- `schema_version` const `v1`
- `repository`, `fetched_at`, `ttl_seconds`, nullable `etag`
- `runs[]` with required fields: `id`, `status`, `conclusion`, `name`, `workflow_id`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `head_branch`, `event`, `run_attempt`, `html_url`
- Include schema evolution guidance in `description`/`$comment` fields.
- Persisted cache artifact per repository on `ai-memory` branch (repo-scoped file).

4. API/interface changes
- New CLI surface:
- `python3 scripts/ai_memory.py actions-runs-cache get --repo owner/repo`
- `python3 scripts/ai_memory.py actions-runs-cache put --repo owner/repo --runs-file /tmp/runs.json --etag "<etag>"`
- New env var:
- `ACTIONS_RUNS_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` (default `60`)
- New warning contract for fail-open cache read/write issues:
- structured `rate_limit_audit_fallback` warning emission (cache miss fallback, no hard failure).

5. Risks and edge cases
- ETag may be missing on responses; loader must still cache/fetch correctly.
- `304` with corrupted/missing cached runs must fail-open to one fresh `200` fetch path.
- Must preserve existing run-selection semantics despite changing from multiple endpoint calls to one shared blob:
- keep equivalent status filtering and list bounds where applicable.
- ai-memory branch push races: rely on existing `persist_memory_operation` retry path; never fail poll tick on cache persistence failure.

6. Testing considerations
- Add ai-memory tests:
- valid payload passes schema
- invalid schema_version/field types fail validation
- `get` returns miss + warning on corruption/mismatch (fail-open)
- `put` rejects malformed runs file and accepts valid one
- Add poller tests:
- two consecutive poll ticks within TTL reuse cache (no duplicate `GET /actions/runs`)
- stale cache performs at most one conditional `200/304` check per tick
- behavior parity for:
- active run detection (queued/in_progress)
- zombie cancellation target selection
- stall judge workflow outcome extraction
- Update/extend any doc/env-var assertion tests if present.

7. Documentation updates
- `README.md`:
- Add `ACTIONS_RUNS_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` to env-var tables.
- Add `H5` changelog section alongside existing H3/H4 operational notes.
- `agents.md`:
- Append new env-var bullet in section 4 env-var reference list (without reordering existing bullets).
